idea.title: The rice cooker beep
idea.summary: Fiction: a stranger keeps vanishing mid-call and he thinks he's boring, but it's her rice cooker beeping, and she ends up talking him through his first pot of rice.
hookOptions: She kept saying one second, then vanished
The stranger kept disappearing every ten minutes
Why does she keep leaving the call?
He thought he was boring her

scenes.say: A stranger kept saying one second, then going quiet for a whole minute.
It was her rice cooker, beeping from the kitchen, and he thought she was bored.

scenes.name: Steamy Owl

messages.text: you keep leaving. am i that boring
no!! the rice cooker keeps beeping
i have never made rice in my life

scenes.say: So he finally said it out loud.
She laughed, because he'd been eating cereal for dinner, and said fine, rice, now.

scenes.name: Steamy Owl
scenes.label: Two kitchens, one pot
scenes.say: She talked him through it, one beep at a time, until both kitchens smelled the same.
